ruling.explanation: To both parties: this ruling leaves the fare exactly as charged (SGD 19.39, payment status CHARGED, refund issued 0.00), because the route deviation the rider describes is not established on the numbers, and no other ground in the policy reaches the same money. Trip TRP-09112 ran from Mandai Estate to Seletar West. The booked optimal route is 10.0 km (trip_record.optimal_distance_km); the GPS trace for the completed trip is 11.5 km (gps_trace.trace_distance_km, the governing field under POL-RD-01 — trip_record.actual_distance_km is the rounded copy of the same measurement and was not used for the test). The excess is 1.50 km. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is greater than 20% of the optimal AND greater than 0.8 km; both tests must pass. The absolute limb passes (1.50 > 0.8), but 1.50 km is 15.0% of 10.0 km, short of the 20% limb. One limb fails, so no deviation exists on this trip, and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised. The rider was right to be straight about that arithmetic in his own brief, and the driver's reading of the same two limbs is adopted. POL-RD-02 (the fare recomputation) runs only where a deviation is established; it therefore does not run, and the rider's hypothetical refund of 1.69 (which the arithmetic would produce if the gate were passed) is not payable because the gate is not passed. There is no separate billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4): the ledger reconciles line by line (3.80 base + 8.63 distance + 6.16 time + 0.80 platform = 19.39), the 8.63 distance line is the trace's own 11.5 km at 0.75/km, the erp_gantries array is empty, there are no tolls, and the airport surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither starts nor ends at an airport. Every charged line has a counterpart, so nothing is refundable as a standalone pass-through correction and no billing-integrity referral arises. On the exculpatory clauses, none is needed and none is available: POL-RD-03 has no advisory to run on — EV-ADVIS-09112-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) and no closure is asserted by anyone, so it exonerates nothing; POL-RD-04 cannot run on the chat log, whose only message (rider, 14:21:40, 'This looks a little longer than the route shown at booking') names no road or place and has waypoint_hint null, so the corroboration test is undecidable and the clause is unavailable; POL-RD-05 has no relocation (all amendment fields null); and POL-RD-12 has no application (vehicle type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL), so the 10.0 km booked optimal stands as the comparator throughout. On the evidence itself, the trace is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 133 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so limbs (a) to (c) are not engaged, the measurements stand, and no escalation under POL-RD-10(3) arises; the platform-wide confidence floor of 0.70 is not approached. On the parties' assertions: the driver's counterparty statement ('I stayed on ordinary through roads and made no additional stop') points to no evidence ID and carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and it was not relied on either way. On the profiles: POL-GEN-01 applies — no profile field is used as a ground of decision. Specifically, rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 additional-corroboration condition is not met, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 610 completed trips in 90 days, so POL-RD-06's repeat-pattern test is not met and no conduct referral fires. For transparency under POL-GEN-02(3): the only artifact below weight 1.0 is EV-ADVIS-09112-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0, code MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no deciding fact here, so it neither drags the confidence nor is it relied upon. The deciding facts (the 11.5 km trace distance and the 10.0 km booked optimal) are carried by EV-GPS-09112 and EV-TRIP-09112, each at weight 1.0, which sets the confidence cap at 1.0. The result is NO_ACTION: the rider's claim is not supported by the evidence, the fare stands, and no amount moves in either direction.
